description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007 Order under Section 05
reasoning: This gazette content is an order made under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007, which modifies the application of an existing regulation (waiving off balance amounts after collecting Rs. 1.00 per Kg from the applicable levy). It involves regulatory changes to import duties and falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes. The mention of Basil Rajapaksa as Minister of Finance is incidental to the regulatory action being taken, not the primary focus of the gazette.
